rows.grounds: compound of dviguṇa (double) and anta (end, limit)
indeclinable combination of api (also) and evam (thus)
past passive participle of īr (to declare, state)

items.question: What maximum limit is prescribed for the length of the throne?
premises: The length of the throne may be extended.
The prescribed extension reaches up to double the measure.
This rule is also declared in the same manner.
items.inference: The throne's length may be prescribed to extend up to twice its base measure.
items.plain_english: In length it should be prescribed to extend up to double, as has also been thus declared.
